generator.layout: BASIC; independent scalar masks, no shaping or kerning
generator.mode: L mask to white RGBA8 with mask alpha
generator.packing: scalar-sorted shelves, width 512, two transparent pixels between frames, power-of-two height
generator.runtime: immutable ATX1/metrics only; no font lookup, parsing, rasterization or network

coverage.description: Printable ASCII, available Latin-1 and Latin Extended-A, selected punctuation/arrows/symbols; see exact supported_scalars in metrics.json.
coverage.unsupported: Other scalars including combining marks, bidi controls and shaped scripts require explicit diagnostics; original UTF-8 is preserved by consumers.
